decoded:
Catering quote from Saffron Bites came in.
Main spread on the 15th offering two tiers.
Tier A at $48 per head includes seared tuna canapés, braised short rib station, full dessert display.
Tier B at $37 per head swaps short rib for mushroom Wellington station, cuts dessert display to chocolate torte and berry pavlovas.
My read: we need to stick with Tier A for primary sponsor dinner in the Veridian Room, but could use Tier B for general attendee reception in the Atrium if budget is squeezed.
However, their minimum for any single service is 70 guests.
If final headcount for the Veridian Room is under 70, we need to pad with organizing committee members to hit the minimum.
We promised them the full experience.
Timing: they need final menu selection and guaranteed guest numbers by 5 p.m. this Thursday, the 7th.
They offered a 3% discount if we wire 50% deposit by Friday at noon instead of the following Monday.
Remaining balance due on the 13th.
Late-night snack delivery for tech crew at 11 p.m. is a separate order of 15 boxed meals, not part of the per-head calculation.
Last year incident: pine nut puree cannot be repeated. Their standard recipe includes it, so this requires specific amendment.
^ Move people on the Atrium list only if absolutely necessary.
^ If Atrium count is between 70 and 90, approve Tier B.
^ If Atrium count exceeds 90, switch to Tier A.
^ Confirm wire details with Aris in Finance. Use vendor code CAT-882.
^ If discount applies, note explicitly in payment authorization.
^ Double-check proposal includes late-night snack delivery for tech crew at 11 p.m., separate order of 15 boxed meals, not part of the per-head calculation.
^ If we go with Tier B anywhere, get written confirmation from Saffron Bites to exclude all nut-based ingredients from the mushroom Wellington filling.
